description: Builds the webinar on the connected WordPress site: the campaign with title, date and room type, the registration page and the room, and it returns both links. Take it when the facts are settled, for example "Good, now put it on my site." It needs the session id, and since it creates real content on the host's site, the host should say a clear yes first. It answers within seconds while the pages are still being built, so show that progress card and read the build status until it is done. Do not start it a second time for the same webinar. Words hosts use: build the webinar, registration page, put it online, my site
